text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: N-Not a single one~!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Um, you know... that girl we practiced 
making friends with at the park—do you 
remember her?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
We actually exchanged LANE contacts and 
keep in touch sometimes. And well—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
She tells me things like, "I was still 
nervous, but I went to school," or "Today 
I tried talking to that girl." She's 
trying so hard right now.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
And during our chats, she mentioned that 
she wanted to see photos of me at the 
academy—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
If I'm showing her, I wanted it to be an 
encouraging picture! Like, with me in the 
center, totally surrounded by friends!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
So I looked for one... and umm... 
......... Huh? W-Wait a second...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
There's literally not a single one! For 
some reason, I'm always off on the very 
edge!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, whenever someone says 
"let's take a picture!", my body just 
naturally yields and steps aside like, "Go 
right ahead, after you~"!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Or rather, I end up being the one taking 
the picture most of the time. I just do it 
because I enjoy it, but...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
If her coach is like this, wouldn't that 
make her worried instead...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, it wasn't as though she lacked 
friends. Which meant if she wanted to take 
such a picture, she easily could—
choice_data_list: Why not just take one right now?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sounds fun! Let's do it! Actually, the 
more the merrier, right? I'll call some 
others!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Sorry for the trouble, but thank you 
so much~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the photoshoot with Dantsu Flame 
surrounded by friends began! —However...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no! Your expression is way too 
stiff, Dantsu! Come on, look more natural! 
Big smile!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
Isn't your pose a bit stiff too? Relax 
more, nice and loose!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Wahhh, this is so hard~!
choice_data_list:
She really can't shake off the stiffness, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorryyy... The moment I think about 
being right in the middle, I get all 
fidgety...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Uwahh... What should I do~? Do you have 
any good ideas?
choice_data_list:
Let's keep trying until we get a good 
expression!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Keep trying...! You mean, aiming for that 
one miracle shot?!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I think that's our only option! 
Alright everyone, if we're doing this, 
let's go all out!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu's Friends
text_block_list.text: Ohhh!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
W-Wah, thank you, everyone...! A-Alright, 
let's do this~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Still too stiff, way too stiff! Your mouth 
is twitching, Dantsu!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
Be "natural" all the way to your 
fingertips! Smile like you always do, look 
over here—yes, like that!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dantsu Flame's photoshoot continued all 
the way until the sun began to set—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
*pant, huff, pant, huff*...! H-How does it 
look~?!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu's Friend A
text_block_list.text: ... ...Yeah, it's perfect!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Y-Yaaay~...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We managed to take the best possible 
photo! —A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Huh? How did they react? ...Fufu, she was 
really happy with it.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Though maybe because we took so many 
shots, my smile ended up looking a little 
too posed.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
She told me, "It looks like a movie 
poster!" Ahahaha~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It didn't turn out quite as expected... 
but all's well that ends well, and Dantsu 
Flame looked delighted.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I get it! I just need to deliberately 
put myself in a situation where it's 
easier to do, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A situation where she can smile carefree 
in the center—in other words, a situation 
where she feels no awkwardness standing 
there. When you put it that way, it has to 
be—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Winning... a race...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaahhhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our training match began. It was a 
one-on-one showdown against her friend, 
Jungle Pocket!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I figured, if I'm gonna win— and feel 
happy from the bottom of my heart, it has 
to be against Pokke-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heh? ...Well, I get your point. But don't 
think I'm gonna let you win just for that!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even though it was just a practice match, 
the race heated up— ...and soon, the two 
entered the final corner.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Jungle Pocket pulls away from Dantsu 
Flame. Rapidly widening the gap to what 
seems an unreachable lead—and yet!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Here I gooooo!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dantsu Flame accelerated as well! Even as 
she was mercilessly pulled apart, she 
pushed forward without a single doubt!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Roaring, kicking up the turf, contorting 
her whole body. And then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, I had captured her 
reckless charge toward the goal with my 
camera.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Uuugh, I lost. Guess it's not that easy.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? ...Whoa.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, wow, this photo is amazing!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I think I'll send this one. To show her 
that I have the greatest rival ever...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't what we had originally planned 
to capture... but Dantsu Flame looked 
thoroughly satisfied.
